name.predicate: Institution source names equal to, beginning with, or containing every distinctive word of the supplied name (case, punctuation, terminal legal form and FCU normalized). Applied to the whole catalog before paging.

limitations: This text carries a labeled NMLS or LEI value. Identifiers use the exact-identifier operation; this operation searches institution NAMES only.
